func customerKey(c store.Customer) cursor { return cursor{T: c.CreatedAt, ID: c.ID} }

// listCustomers lists the organization's customers, oldest first: all of them, those matching ?q= (name or email contains
// it, ignoring case), or the one with exactly ?email=.
func (s *Server) listCustomers(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	pg, ok := parsePage(w, r)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	q := r.URL.Query()
	var cs []store.Customer
	switch {
	case q.Get("email") != "":
		cs = []store.Customer{}
		if c, ok := s.store.FindCustomerByEmail(p.OrgID, q.Get("email")); ok {
			cs = append(cs, c)
		}
	case q.Get("q") != "":
		cs = s.store.SearchCustomers(p.OrgID, q.Get("q"))
	default:
		cs = s.store.Customers(p.OrgID)
	}
	items, next := pageOf(cs, customerKey, pg)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, list{Items: items, NextCursor: next})
}

func (s *Server) createCustomer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	var in struct {
		Name                 string            `json:"name"`
		Email                string            `json:"email"`
		DefaultPaymentMethod string            `json:"default_payment_method"`
		Metadata             map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
	}
	if !decode(w, r, &in) {
		return
	}
	c, err := s.store.CreateCustomer(p.OrgID, in.Name, in.Email, s.clock.Now())
	if err != nil {
		s.storeError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if in.DefaultPaymentMethod != "" || len(in.Metadata) > 0 {
		c, err = s.store.UpdateCustomer(p.OrgID, c.ID, func(c *store.Customer) error {
			c.DefaultPaymentMethod, c.Metadata = in.DefaultPaymentMethod, in.Metadata
			return nil
		})
		if err != nil {
			_ = s.store.DeleteCustomer(p.OrgID, c.ID)
			s.storeError(w, err)
			return
		}
	}
	s.publish(r.Context(), p.OrgID, "customer.created", c)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, c)
}

func (s *Server) getCustomer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	c, ok := s.store.Customer(p.OrgID, r.PathValue("id"))
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "no such customer")
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, c)
}

func (s *Server) updateCustomer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	var in struct {
		Name                 *string            `json:"name"`
		Email                *string            `json:"email"`
		DefaultPaymentMethod *string            `json:"default_payment_method"`
		Metadata             *map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
	}
	if !decode(w, r, &in) {
		return
	}
	c, err := s.store.UpdateCustomer(p.OrgID, r.PathValue("id"), func(c *store.Customer) error {
		if in.Name != nil {
			c.Name = *in.Name
		}
		if in.Email != nil {
			c.Email = *in.Email
		}
		if in.DefaultPaymentMethod != nil {
			c.DefaultPaymentMethod = *in.DefaultPaymentMethod
		}
		if in.Metadata != nil {
			c.Metadata = *in.Metadata
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		s.storeError(w, err)
		return
	}
	s.publish(r.Context(), p.OrgID, "customer.updated", c)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, c)
}

func (s *Server) deleteCustomer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	id := r.PathValue("id")
	if err := s.store.DeleteCustomer(p.OrgID, id); err != nil {
		s.storeError(w, err)
		return
	}
	s.publish(r.Context(), p.OrgID, "customer.deleted", map[string]string{"id": id})
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// exportCustomers answers the organization's customers as CSV, oldest first.
func (s *Server) exportCustomers(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/csv; charset=utf-8")
	w.Header().Set("Content-Disposition", `attachment; filename="customers.csv"`)
	cw := csv.NewWriter(w)
	cw.UseCRLF = true
	_ = cw.Write([]string{"id", "name", "email", "created_at"})
	for _, c := range s.store.Customers(p.OrgID) {
		_ = cw.Write([]string{c.ID, c.Name, c.Email, c.CreatedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)})
	}
	cw.Flush()
}

// Options configure a Server.
type Options struct {
	Clock         clock.Clock            // nil: clock.Real
	Payments      *payments.Service      // required
	Subscriptions *subscriptions.Service // required
	Webhooks      *webhooks.Service      // nil: a service with the default HTTP client and resolver
	Mail          mail.Sender            // nil: an Outbox (nothing is sent)
	Logger        *slog.Logger           // nil: discard
	// BaseURL is the dashboard's address, for links in emails (default "https://app.tally.example").
	BaseURL string
}

// Server serves the API.
type Server struct {
	store   *store.Store
	clock   clock.Clock
	pay     *payments.Service
	subs    *subscriptions.Service
	hooks   *webhooks.Service
	mail    mail.Sender
	log     *slog.Logger
	baseURL string
	mux     *http.ServeMux
	handler http.Handler
}

// New returns a server over a store.
func New(st *store.Store, opt Options) *Server {
	if opt.Payments == nil || opt.Subscriptions == nil {
		panic("api.New: Options.Payments and Options.Subscriptions are required")
	}
	s := &Server{store: st, clock: opt.Clock, pay: opt.Payments, subs: opt.Subscriptions, hooks: opt.Webhooks, mail: opt.Mail, log: opt.Logger,
		baseURL: strings.TrimRight(opt.BaseURL, "/"), mux: http.NewServeMux()}
	if s.clock == nil {
		s.clock = clock.Real{}
	}
	if s.hooks == nil {
		s.hooks = webhooks.New(webhooks.Options{Store: st, Clock: s.clock})
	}
	if s.mail == nil {
		s.mail = &mail.Outbox{}
	}
	if s.log == nil {
		s.log = slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(io.Discard, nil))
	}
	if s.baseURL == "" {
		s.baseURL = "https://app.tally.example"
	}
	s.routes()
	s.handler = s.withRequestID(s.recoverPanics(s.mux))
	return s
}

// handler is an endpoint that runs for a known member.
type handler func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal)

// authed resolves the request's API key to the member it acts for, or answers 401. Viewers may only read: any other method
// answers 403.
func (s *Server) authed(h handler) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		token, ok := strings.CutPrefix(r.Header.Get("Authorization"), "Bearer ")
		if !ok {
			writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "send an API key as Authorization: Bearer <token>")
			return
		}
		key, ok := s.store.APIKeyByToken(strings.TrimSpace(token))
		if !ok || key.RevokedAt != nil {
			writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "unknown or revoked API key")
			return
		}
		m, ok := s.store.Member(key.OrgID, key.UserID)
		if !ok {
			writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "the key's owner is no longer a member")
			return
		}
		s.store.TouchAPIKey(key.ID, s.clock.Now())
		p := auth.Principal{OrgID: key.OrgID, UserID: key.UserID, KeyID: key.ID, Role: m.Role}
		if r.Method != http.MethodGet && !auth.CanWrite(p.Role) {
			writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden", "viewers can only read")
			return
		}
		h(w, r, p)
	}
}

type ctxKey int

const requestIDKey ctxKey = 0

var requestIDRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$`)

// withRequestID gives every request an ID: the caller's X-Request-Id when it is sensible, a new one otherwise. It is sent
// back in the X-Request-Id header.
func (s *Server) withRequestID(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		id := r.Header.Get("X-Request-Id")
		if !requestIDRe.MatchString(id) {
			b := make([]byte, 8)
			_, _ = rand.Read(b)
			id = "req_" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
		}
		w.Header().Set("X-Request-Id", id)
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(context.WithValue(r.Context(), requestIDKey, id)))
	})
}

// RequestID returns the ID of the request ctx belongs to.
func RequestID(ctx context.Context) string {
	id, _ := ctx.Value(requestIDKey).(string)
	return id
}

func (s *Server) recoverPanics(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		defer func() {
			if v := recover(); v != nil {
				s.log.Error("panic", "method", r.Method, "path", r.URL.Path, "panic", v, "request_id", RequestID(r.Context()))
				writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal", "something went wrong")
			}
		}()
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

func (s *Server) publish(ctx context.Context, orgID, typ string, data any) {
	if err := s.hooks.Publish(ctx, orgID, typ, data); err != nil {
		s.log.Error("publish event", "type", typ, "err", err)
	}
}
package api

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"time"

	"example.com/tally/internal/store"
)

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, v any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v)
}

// writeError answers {"error": code, "message": message}.
func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code, message string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]string{"error": code, "message": message})
}

// decode reads a JSON body (at most 1 MiB) into v, or answers 400 and returns false.
func decode(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, v any) bool {
	dec := json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(r.Body, 1<<20))
	if err := dec.Decode(v); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_json", "the body is not valid JSON: "+err.Error())
		return false
	}
	return true
}

// storeError answers for an error from the store or a service.
func (s *Server) storeError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound):
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "no such object")
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrEmailTaken):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "email_taken", err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrAlreadyMember):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "already_member", err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrConflict):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "conflict", err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrCustomerOrgMismatch):
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "customer_org_mismatch", err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrInvalid):
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid", err.Error())
	default:
		s.log.Error("request failed", "err", err)
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal", "something went wrong")
	}
}

// list is the shape of every list response. NextCursor is set when there is another page.
type list struct {
	Items      any    `json:"items"`
	NextCursor string `json:"next_cursor,omitempty"`
}

// page is a request for one page of a list: ?limit= (1 to 100, default 20) and ?cursor= (from the previous page).
type page struct {
	limit int
	after *cursor
}

// cursor is where a page starts: after the item with this creation time and ID.
type cursor struct {
	T  time.Time `json:"t"`
	ID string    `json:"id"`
}

func (c cursor) less(o cursor) bool {
	if !c.T.Equal(o.T) {
		return c.T.Before(o.T)
	}
	return c.ID < o.ID
}

// parsePage reads ?limit and ?cursor, or answers 400 and returns false.
func parsePage(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) (page, bool) {
	p := page{limit: 20}
	if v := r.URL.Query().Get("limit"); v != "" {
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
		if err != nil || n < 1 || n > 100 {
			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_limit", "limit is a whole number from 1 to 100")
			return page{}, false
		}
		p.limit = n
	}
	if v := r.URL.Query().Get("cursor"); v != "" {
		b, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(v)
		var c cursor
		if err != nil || json.Unmarshal(b, &c) != nil || c.ID == "" {
			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_cursor", "the cursor is not one this API gave out")
			return page{}, false
		}
		p.after = &c
	}
	return p, true
}

func encodeCursor(c cursor) string {
	b, _ := json.Marshal(c)
	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(b)
}

// pageOf returns one page of items, which are sorted by key (creation time, then ID), and the cursor of the next page.
func pageOf[T any](items []T, key func(T) cursor, p page) ([]T, string) {
	start := 0
	if p.after != nil {
		start = len(items)
		for i, it := range items {
			if p.after.less(key(it)) {
				start = i
				break
			}
		}
	}
	end := min(start+p.limit, len(items))
	out := items[start:end]
	next := ""
	if end < len(items) && len(out) > 0 {
		next = encodeCursor(key(out[len(out)-1]))
	}
	return out, next
}

func customerKey(c store.Customer) cursor { return cursor{T: c.CreatedAt, ID: c.ID} }

// listCustomers lists the organization's customers, oldest first: all of them, those matching ?q= (name or email contains
// it, ignoring case), or the one with exactly ?email=.
func (s *Server) listCustomers(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	pg, ok := parsePage(w, r)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	q := r.URL.Query()
	var cs []store.Customer
	switch {
	case q.Get("email") != "":
		cs = []store.Customer{}
		if c, ok := s.store.FindCustomerByEmail(p.OrgID, q.Get("email")); ok {
			cs = append(cs, c)
		}
	case q.Get("q") != "":
		cs = s.store.SearchCustomers(p.OrgID, q.Get("q"))
	default:
		cs = s.store.Customers(p.OrgID)
	}
	items, next := pageOf(cs, customerKey, pg)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, list{Items: items, NextCursor: next})
}

func (s *Server) createCustomer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	var in struct {
		Name                 string            `json:"name"`
		Email                string            `json:"email"`
		DefaultPaymentMethod string            `json:"default_payment_method"`
		Metadata             map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
	}
	if !decode(w, r, &in) {
		return
	}
	c, err := s.store.CreateCustomer(p.OrgID, in.Name, in.Email, s.clock.Now())
	if err != nil {
		s.storeError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if in.DefaultPaymentMethod != "" || len(in.Metadata) > 0 {
		c, err = s.store.UpdateCustomer(p.OrgID, c.ID, func(c *store.Customer) error {
			c.DefaultPaymentMethod, c.Metadata = in.DefaultPaymentMethod, in.Metadata
			return nil
		})
		if err != nil {
			_ = s.store.DeleteCustomer(p.OrgID, c.ID)
			s.storeError(w, err)
			return
		}
	}
	s.publish(r.Context(), p.OrgID, "customer.created", c)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, c)
}

func (s *Server) getCustomer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	c, ok := s.store.Customer(p.OrgID, r.PathValue("id"))
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "no such customer")
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, c)
}

func (s *Server) updateCustomer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	var in struct {
		Name                 *string            `json:"name"`
		Email                *string            `json:"email"`
		DefaultPaymentMethod *string            `json:"default_payment_method"`
		Metadata             *map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
	}
	if !decode(w, r, &in) {
		return
	}
	c, err := s.store.UpdateCustomer(p.OrgID, r.PathValue("id"), func(c *store.Customer) error {
		if in.Name != nil {
			c.Name = *in.Name
		}
		if in.Email != nil {
			c.Email = *in.Email
		}
		if in.DefaultPaymentMethod != nil {
			c.DefaultPaymentMethod = *in.DefaultPaymentMethod
		}
		if in.Metadata != nil {
			c.Metadata = *in.Metadata
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		s.storeError(w, err)
		return
	}
	s.publish(r.Context(), p.OrgID, "customer.updated", c)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, c)
}

func (s *Server) deleteCustomer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	id := r.PathValue("id")
	if err := s.store.DeleteCustomer(p.OrgID, id); err != nil {
		s.storeError(w, err)
		return
	}
	s.publish(r.Context(), p.OrgID, "customer.deleted", map[string]string{"id": id})
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// exportCustomers answers the organization's customers as CSV, oldest first.
func (s *Server) exportCustomers(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/csv; charset=utf-8")
	w.Header().Set("Content-Disposition", `attachment; filename="customers.csv"`)
	cw := csv.NewWriter(w)
	cw.UseCRLF = true
	_ = cw.Write([]string{"id", "name", "email", "created_at"})
	for _, c := range s.store.Customers(p.OrgID) {
		_ = cw.Write([]string{c.ID, c.Name, c.Email, c.CreatedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)})
	}
	cw.Flush()
}

// Options configure a Server.
type Options struct {
	Clock         clock.Clock            // nil: clock.Real
	Payments      *payments.Service      // required
	Subscriptions *subscriptions.Service // required
	Webhooks      *webhooks.Service      // nil: a service with the default HTTP client and resolver
	Mail          mail.Sender            // nil: an Outbox (nothing is sent)
	Logger        *slog.Logger           // nil: discard
	// BaseURL is the dashboard's address, for links in emails (default "https://app.tally.example").
	BaseURL string
}

// Server serves the API.
type Server struct {
	store   *store.Store
	clock   clock.Clock
	pay     *payments.Service
	subs    *subscriptions.Service
	hooks   *webhooks.Service
	mail    mail.Sender
	log     *slog.Logger
	baseURL string
	mux     *http.ServeMux
	handler http.Handler
}

// New returns a server over a store.
func New(st *store.Store, opt Options) *Server {
	if opt.Payments == nil || opt.Subscriptions == nil {
		panic("api.New: Options.Payments and Options.Subscriptions are required")
	}
	s := &Server{store: st, clock: opt.Clock, pay: opt.Payments, subs: opt.Subscriptions, hooks: opt.Webhooks, mail: opt.Mail, log: opt.Logger,
		baseURL: strings.TrimRight(opt.BaseURL, "/"), mux: http.NewServeMux()}
	if s.clock == nil {
		s.clock = clock.Real{}
	}
	if s.hooks == nil {
		s.hooks = webhooks.New(webhooks.Options{Store: st, Clock: s.clock})
	}
	if s.mail == nil {
		s.mail = &mail.Outbox{}
	}
	if s.log == nil {
		s.log = slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(io.Discard, nil))
	}
	if s.baseURL == "" {
		s.baseURL = "https://app.tally.example"
	}
	s.routes()
	s.handler = s.withRequestID(s.recoverPanics(s.mux))
	return s
}

// handler is an endpoint that runs for a known member.
type handler func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal)

// authed resolves the request's API key to the member it acts for, or answers 401. Viewers may only read: any other method
// answers 403.
func (s *Server) authed(h handler) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		token, ok := strings.CutPrefix(r.Header.Get("Authorization"), "Bearer ")
		if !ok {
			writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "send an API key as Authorization: Bearer <token>")
			return
		}
		key, ok := s.store.APIKeyByToken(strings.TrimSpace(token))
		if !ok || key.RevokedAt != nil {
			writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "unknown or revoked API key")
			return
		}
		m, ok := s.store.Member(key.OrgID, key.UserID)
		if !ok {
			writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "the key's owner is no longer a member")
			return
		}
		s.store.TouchAPIKey(key.ID, s.clock.Now())
		p := auth.Principal{OrgID: key.OrgID, UserID: key.UserID, KeyID: key.ID, Role: m.Role}
		if r.Method != http.MethodGet && !auth.CanWrite(p.Role) {
			writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden", "viewers can only read")
			return
		}
		h(w, r, p)
	}
}

type ctxKey int

const requestIDKey ctxKey = 0

var requestIDRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$`)

// withRequestID gives every request an ID: the caller's X-Request-Id when it is sensible, a new one otherwise. It is sent
// back in the X-Request-Id header.
func (s *Server) withRequestID(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		id := r.Header.Get("X-Request-Id")
		if !requestIDRe.MatchString(id) {
			b := make([]byte, 8)
			_, _ = rand.Read(b)
			id = "req_" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
		}
		w.Header().Set("X-Request-Id", id)
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(context.WithValue(r.Context(), requestIDKey, id)))
	})
}

// RequestID returns the ID of the request ctx belongs to.
func RequestID(ctx context.Context) string {
	id, _ := ctx.Value(requestIDKey).(string)
	return id
}

func (s *Server) recoverPanics(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		defer func() {
			if v := recover(); v != nil {
				s.log.Error("panic", "method", r.Method, "path", r.URL.Path, "panic", v, "request_id", RequestID(r.Context()))
				writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal", "something went wrong")
			}
		}()
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

func (s *Server) publish(ctx context.Context, orgID, typ string, data any) {
	if err := s.hooks.Publish(ctx, orgID, typ, data); err != nil {
		s.log.Error("publish event", "type", typ, "err", err)
	}
}

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"time"

	"example.com/tally/internal/store"
)

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, v any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v)
}

// writeError answers {"error": code, "message": message}.
func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code, message string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]string{"error": code, "message": message})
}

// decode reads a JSON body (at most 1 MiB) into v, or answers 400 and returns false.
func decode(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, v any) bool {
	dec := json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(r.Body, 1<<20))
	if err := dec.Decode(v); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_json", "the body is not valid JSON: "+err.Error())
		return false
	}
	return true
}

// storeError answers for an error from the store or a service.
func (s *Server) storeError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound):
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "no such object")
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrEmailTaken):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "email_taken", err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrAlreadyMember):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "already_member", err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrConflict):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "conflict", err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrCustomerOrgMismatch):
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "customer_org_mismatch", err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrInvalid):
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid", err.Error())
	default:
		s.log.Error("request failed", "err", err)
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal", "something went wrong")
	}
}

// list is the shape of every list response. NextCursor is set when there is another page.
type list struct {
	Items      any    `json:"items"`
	NextCursor string `json:"next_cursor,omitempty"`
}

// page is a request for one page of a list: ?limit= (1 to 100, default 20) and ?cursor= (from the previous page).
type page struct {
	limit int
	after *cursor
}

// cursor is where a page starts: after the item with this creation time and ID.
type cursor struct {
	T  time.Time `json:"t"`
	ID string    `json:"id"`
}

func (c cursor) less(o cursor) bool {
	if !c.T.Equal(o.T) {
		return c.T.Before(o.T)
	}
	return c.ID < o.ID
}

// parsePage reads ?limit and ?cursor, or answers 400 and returns false.
func parsePage(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) (page, bool) {
	p := page{limit: 20}
	if v := r.URL.Query().Get("limit"); v != "" {
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
		if err != nil || n < 1 || n > 100 {
			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_limit", "limit is a whole number from 1 to 100")
			return page{}, false
		}
		p.limit = n
	}
	if v := r.URL.Query().Get("cursor"); v != "" {
		b, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(v)
		var c cursor
		if err != nil || json.Unmarshal(b, &c) != nil || c.ID == "" {
			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_cursor", "the cursor is not one this API gave out")
			return page{}, false
		}
		p.after = &c
	}
	return p, true
}

func encodeCursor(c cursor) string {
	b, _ := json.Marshal(c)
	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(b)
}

// pageOf returns one page of items, which are sorted by key (creation time, then ID), and the cursor of the next page.
func pageOf[T any](items []T, key func(T) cursor, p page) ([]T, string) {
	start := 0
	if p.after != nil {
		start = len(items)
		for i, it := range items {
			if p.after.less(key(it)) {
				start = i
				break
			}
		}
	}
	end := min(start+p.limit, len(items))
	out := items[start:end]
	next := ""
	if end < len(items) && len(out) > 0 {
		next = encodeCursor(key(out[len(out)-1]))
	}
	return out, next
}
